partnership.description: Mindsprint and monday.com announced a strategic partnership combining monday.com's AI work platform capabilities with Mindsprint's expertise in process re-engineering and enterprise transformation. The collaboration delivers integrated solutions spanning IT Service Management, CRM, and Work Management unified within the monday.com ecosystem. Partnership aims to help organizations reduce operational complexity, break down silos, and drive transformation through real-time insights and agile ways of working.
partnership.name: Mindsprint

partnership.description: monday.com is integrated as a partner plugin in Microsoft's Copilot Cowork platform, which is now generally available to all Microsoft 365 Copilot users worldwide. The platform combines Microsoft's Copilot with Anthropic's Claude AI tools and includes partner plugins from monday.com, Miro, Moodys, Adobe, Atlassian, Box, and Canva. monday.com holds 5.05% of global ChatGPT impressions according to advertising research.
partnership.name: Microsoft

partnership.description: Bengaluru Police partnered with Monday Ventures and Aeos to launch an AI-powered multilingual feature in their Namma 112 emergency helpline. The technology, developed in partnership with Monday Ventures and Aeos, removes language barriers by supporting over 10 Indian and foreign languages. Monday Ventures is monday.com's $200 million venture capital arm focused on AI startups.
partnership.name: Aeos (via monday Ventures)

partnership.description: monday.com integrates Anthropic's Claude AI models through one-click connectors, enabling users to access Claude capabilities within the monday.com workflow. monday.com was featured as a case study at Anthropic's Code with Claude developer event showcasing how companies are reshaping development teams around Claude Code. Anthropic's Claude Cowork product competes with Monday.com's AI agent positioning.
partnership.name: Anthropic

partnership.description: monday.com integrates OpenAI's ChatGPT through one-click connectors, enabling users to access ChatGPT capabilities within monday.com workflows. Monday.com holds 5.05% of global ChatGPT impressions and eight of the top 10 advertisers on ChatGPT are B2B SaaS brands.
partnership.name: OpenAI

partnership.description: monday.com integrates Google Gemini through one-click connectors and offers Google Calendar, Google Drive, and Gmail integrations. monday.com MCP (Model Context Protocol) enables connectivity to Google AI ecosystem tools.
partnership.name: Google

recent_move.description: Launched the AI Work Platform in May 2026, embedding native AI agents (monday agents), Agent Factory no-code builder, monday sidekick, and monday vibe into core architecture, described by the company as the biggest transformation in its history.

Introduced seats-plus-credits pricing model in May 2026, hybridizing per-seat subscriptions with AI consumption credits to address per-seat SaaS collapse concerns and capture AI workload monetization.
Agreed to acquire OneAI in May 2026 to add voice agent capabilities to the platform, expanding multimodal AI coverage alongside text, image, and code.
Launched monday Ventures in June 2026 with up to $200M allocated to AI startup investments, with $50M initially deployed across Blocks.diy, Guidde, and NanoCo, building ecosystem and pipeline.

Designated Singapore as second Asia-Pacific headquarters alongside Sydney in June 2026, opening October 2025, appointing Chris Jordan to lead operations and targeting expansion beyond SMEs into family conglomerates across Southeast Asia and India.

Repurchased approximately $553 million of shares (roughly 10% of shares outstanding) in Q1 2026 against a backdrop of multiple securities class action lawsuits alleging misstatements during the September 2025-February 2026 period.

leadership_change.description: monday.com repositioned as an AI Work Platform, describing this as the biggest change in company history, enabling people and AI agents to work together across all workflows and departments with native AI agents.
leadership_change.title: AI Work Platform Transformation

leadership_change.description: monday.com appointed Chris Jordan to lead its Singapore operations, establishing the city as its second Asia Pacific headquarters alongside existing operations to accelerate growth across Southeast Asia and India.
leadership_change.title: Singapore APAC Headquarters

leadership_change.description: monday.com promoted Ben Barnett to General Manager for Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, based in London, overseeing the company's EMEA go-to-market strategy and strategic partnerships.
leadership_change.title: Ben Barnett EMEA Promotion

leadership_change.description: monday.com launched a new seats-plus-credits pricing model, described as the biggest change in its history, aligning revenue with AI-driven workload consumption.
leadership_change.title: Seats-Plus-Credits Pricing Model Launch

leadership_change.description: monday.com launched monday Ventures, a new venture capital arm with plans to invest up to $200 million in artificial intelligence startups as part of its strategic shift from work management to AI-agent platform.
leadership_change.title: Monday Ventures Launch

expansion_highlight.description: Singapore established as second APAC headquarters in June 2026 after October 2025 office opening, with Chris Jordan appointed to lead; current APAC contributes only 8% of quarterly revenue, signaling significant runway versus the 26% EMEA YoY growth benchmark.
Acquisition of OneAI in May 2026 adds voice agent capabilities, expanding AI modality coverage beyond text and image into audio workflows including meeting intelligence and voice-driven interactions.

Seats-plus-credits pricing introduced May 2026 enables monetization of AI workload consumption; AI credits already contributed 10% of net new ARR in Q1 2026, opening a usage-based revenue stream distinct from per-seat subscriptions.

monday Ventures ($200M fund, $50M initially deployed) invests across AI agent, cybersecurity, and enterprise data infrastructure startups, while partnership with Microsoft Copilot Cowork positions monday.com as a default work layer inside the Microsoft AI ecosystem.

Enterprise customers with $500K+ ARR grew 74% YoY with 99 added in Q1 2026, and APAC expansion explicitly targets family conglomerates beyond the historical SME base, signaling a deliberate upmarket and segment expansion.

Ben Barnett promoted to General Manager EMEA and Chris Jordan appointed to lead Singapore in mid-2026; EMEA headcount exceeds 2,250 with London office alone at 370+, indicating continued sales expansion despite flat overall headcount guidance.
